xmldoc.short_description: Set property values from constructor arguments.

param_input_item.param_description: a handle object whose properties are set.
a non-negative integer: the number of arguments supplied by the constructor (usually nargin).
name-value pairs, where each name is a property name string.
names of the properties that may be set by value only, in order, before the name-value pairs.

description.p: setProperties assigns property values to obj from the arguments passed to a constructor. It is the companion of the construction-time property pattern used by System objects.
numArgs is the number of arguments that the constructor received. Any argument supplied after the first numArgs ones is interpreted as the name of a property that may be set by value only.

The first arguments are consumed by position and assigned, in order, to the value-only property names, until an argument is a property name of obj. From that point, the remaining arguments are read as name-value pairs.
Supplying more value-only arguments than there are value-only property names raises an error; a common cause is a misspelled property name.

example_item.example_item_description: Set properties from a constructor, by value only and by name-value.
